title: Bootkeys
content: Bootkeys is the name given to CyberPetsAI Reboot NFTs in the supplied lore. They are associated with capturing rogue CyberPetsAI companions affected by the Chaos Glitch.

title: Reboot-Keys
content: Reboot-Keys are containment artifacts used by Containment Agents to apply a killswitch command or repair a corrupted companion using repair glitch code, also described as chaos hacks.
